name: io.github.bamr87/fleet
title: bamr87 Harness Console
description: The bamr87 fleet's control plane: fleet status, harness health, jobs, spend and the Work board

environmentVariables.name: DASH_CONSOLE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Harness Console the server wraps; unset means the local console

environmentVariables.name: DASH_CONSOLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The console's bearer token; unset means the line in the repository's .env

environmentVariables.name: HARNESS_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true (or 1) registers the destructive write tools, each still behind confirm=true; off by default

environmentVariables.name: HARNESS_MCP_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of narrow, audited write scopes (jobs, work); empty grants none

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Not a published package: a checkout runs it with tools/console/mcp.sh, which bootstraps .venv-mcp. The streamable HTTP transport (mcp.sh --http) binds loopback only and is not declared as a remote.
